'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Alden Peterson DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alden Peterson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title Strahd. Sheet name variants Alder Peterson / Alden Pierson normalized to Alden Peterson.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Alden Peterson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / Your Fantasy Made Real|Carbon Chamber Testing]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
